name: BoolCircuit.CircuitEval.tr
header:
def tr (exact : Bool) : St → Option Bool → (Fin 2 → Option Bool) → Action 2 Bool St
  | .rd1 φ, some b, _ => LA.toAct .pos (.go (.rd2 φ b))
  | .rd1 _, none, _ => LA.toAct 0 .rej
  | .rd2 φ b, some b', w => match pairSym b b' with
    | some s => LA.toAct .pos (lact φ s (w 0) (w 1))
    | none => LA.toAct 0 .rej
  | .rd2 _ _, none, _ => LA.toAct 0 .rej
  | .rewM, _, w =>
    if (w 1).isSome then LA.toAct 0 ⟨none, none, .neg, none, some .rewM⟩
    else LA.toAct 0 ⟨none, none, .pos, none, some .copy⟩
  | .copy, inp, w =>
    if (w 1).isSome then
      match inp with
      | some b => LA.toAct .pos ⟨some (some b), some none, .pos, none, some .copy⟩
      | none => LA.toAct 0 .rej
    else if exact && inp.isSome then LA.toAct 0 .rej
    else LA.toAct 0 ⟨none, none, .neg, none, some (.rewV none)⟩
  | .rewV d, _, w =>
    if (w 0).isSome then LA.toAct 0 ⟨none, none, .neg, none, some (.rewV d)⟩
    else LA.toAct 0 ⟨none, none, .pos, none, some (match d with
      | none => .rewI0
      | some φ => .rd1 φ)⟩
  | .rewI0, _, _ => FinTM.controlAction .neg (some .rewI)
  | .rewI, inp, _ => match inp with
    | some _ => FinTM.controlAction .neg (some .rewI)
    | none => FinTM.controlAction .pos (some (.rd1 .skipN))
  | .app v, _, w =>
    if (w 0).isSome then LA.toAct 0 ⟨none, some none, .pos, none, some (.app v)⟩
    else LA.toAct 0 ⟨some (some v), some none, .neg, none, some (.rewV (some .g))⟩

private lemma canonStageOuterSpec (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (H : Type) (_ : Fintype H) (_ : DecidableEq H) (P : MultiTapeTM (m + 2) Bool H)
      (anchor escape : H) (bound : Fin m) (A : ℕ), escape ≠ anchor ∧
      ∀ (x w u : List Bool), Nat.ofDigits 2 (u.map Bool.toNat) = counterValue w + 1 →
        ∃ τ : Cfg (m + 2) Bool H x → ℕ,
          ∀ d : Cfg (m + 2) Bool H x,
            (d.output = [] ∧ 1 ≤ d.inputPos.val ∧
              d.workTapes bound.castSucc.castSucc = FinTM.bufferTape w ∧
              d.workTapePos bound.castSucc.castSucc = 0 ∧
              (∀ j : Fin m, j ≠ bound →
                d.workTapes j.castSucc.castSucc = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧
                d.workTapePos j.castSucc.castSucc = 0) ∧
              (∀ q : ℤ, q < 0 ∨ ((3 ^ (k + 1) : ℕ).bits.length : ℤ) ≤ q →
                d.workTapes (Fin.last m).castSucc q = none) ∧
              d.workTapePos (Fin.last m).castSucc = 0 ∧
              d.workTapes (Fin.last (m + 1)) = FinTM.bufferTape u ∧

    (U : MultiTapeTM mU Bool SU) (ue : SU) (ux : Bool → SU) (uBound : Fin mU) (ua : ℕ)
    (uinj : Function.Injective ux)
    (unary : ∀ (x w : List Bool) (d : Cfg mU Bool SU x), d.state = some ue →
      1 ≤ d.inputPos.val →
      d.workTapes uBound = FinTM.bufferTape w → d.workTapePos uBound = 0 →
      (∀ j, j ≠ uBound → d.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ d.workTapePos j = 0) →
      ∃ t ≤ ua * (x.length + w.length + 1),
        (U.runFrom d t).state =
          some (ux (codeSkipFin (counterValue w + 1)
            (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1))).isSome) ∧
        (U.runFrom d t).output = d.output ∧
        (∀ u < t, ∀ v, (U.runFrom d u).state ≠ some (ux v)) ∧
        (U.runFrom d t).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧
        (U.runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos ∧
        ∀ ys, codeSkipFin (counterValue w + 1) (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1)) = some ys →
          (U.runFrom d t).inputPos.val = x.length + 1 - ys.length)
    (header ctrOuter : Fin M) (σ : Fin mU ↪ Fin M) (hσb : σ uBound = header)
    (hσc : ∀ i, σ i ≠ ctrOuter) (hhc : header ≠ ctrOuter) :
    ∃ (H : Type) (_ : Fintype H) (_ : DecidableEq H) (Fr : MultiTapeTM M Bool H)
      (entry : H) (exit : Bool → H) (A : ℕ), Function.Injective exit ∧
      ∀ (x w : List Bool) (d : Cfg M Bool H x), d.state = some entry → d.output = [] →
        1 ≤ d.inputPos.val →
        d.workTapes header = FinTM.bufferTape w → d.workTapePos header = 0 →
        (∀ j, j ≠ header → d.workTapes j = FinTM.bufferTape [] ∧ d.workTapePos j = 0) →
        ∃ t ≤ A * (x.length + w.length + 1), ∃ u : List Bool,
          Nat.ofDigits 2 (u.map Bool.toNat) = counterValue w + 1 ∧
          u.length = w.length + 1 ∧
          (Fr.runFrom d t).state = some (exit (codeSkipFin (counterValue w + 1)
            (x.drop (d.inputPos.val - 1))).isSome) ∧
          (Fr.runFrom d t).output = [] ∧
          (∀ v < t, ∀ b, (Fr.runFrom d v).state ≠ some (exit b)) ∧
          (Fr.runFrom d t).workTapes header = FinTM.bufferTape w ∧
          (Fr.runFrom d t).workTapePos header = 0 ∧

            (Fr.runFrom d t).workTapePos j = 0) ∧

private theorem ss_serialized_layout (n : ℕ) (src tbl sm : Fin n)
    (hst : src ≠ tbl) (hss : src ≠ sm) (hts : tbl ≠ sm) :
    ∃ (Q : Type) (_ : Fintype Q) (_ : DecidableEq Q) (L : MultiTapeTM n Bool Q)
      (entry done : Q) (C : ℕ),
      ∀ {k m : ℕ} (M : MultiTapeTM k Bool (Fin (m + 1))),
        ∃ T ≤ C * ((serializeK M).length + 1),
          ∀ {z : List Bool} (d : Cfg n Bool Q z),
            d.state = some entry →
            d.workTapes src = FinTM.bufferTape (serializeK M) →
            d.workTapePos src = (serializeK M).length →
            d.workTapes tbl = (fun _ => none) → d.workTapePos tbl = 0 →
            d.workTapes sm = (fun _ => none) → d.workTapePos sm = 0 →
            (L.runFrom d T).state = some done ∧
            (L.runFrom d T).inputPos = d.inputPos ∧
            (L.runFrom d T).workTapes =
              Function.update (Function.update (Function.update d.workTapes src
                (fun _ => none)) tbl (FinTM.bufferTape (tableBitsK M.tr)))
                sm (fun p => FinTM.bufferTape (unaryFin M.q₀) (p - 2)) ∧
            (L.runFrom d T).workTapePos =
              Function.update (Function.update (Function.update d.workTapePos src 0) tbl 0)
                sm 0 ∧
            (∀ u ≤ T, (L.runFrom d u).output = d.output) ∧

header:
theorem exists_inputLengthTM :
    ∃ (K : ℕ) (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S) (R : MultiTapeTM (K + 1) Bool S)
      (entry exit : S) (C : ℕ),
      ∀ {x : List Bool} (d : Cfg (K + 1) Bool S x), d.state = some entry → d.inputPos = 1 →
        (∀ p : ℤ, -1 ≤ p → p ≤ ((Nat.bits x.length).length : ℤ) →
          d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + p) = none) →
        (∀ j : Fin (K + 1), j ≠ 0 → ∀ p, d.workTapes j p = none) →
        ∃ t ≤ C * (x.length + 1),
          (∀ u < t, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
          (∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j : Fin (K + 1),
            |(R.runFrom d u).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤
              ((C * ((Nat.bits x.length).length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧
          R.runFrom d t =
            { d with
              state := some exit
              workTapes := fun j q =>
                if j = 0 ∧ d.workTapePos j ≤ q ∧
                    q < d.workTapePos j + ((Nat.bits x.length).length : ℤ)
                  then FinTM.bufferTape (Nat.bits x.length) (q - d.workTapePos j)
                else d.workTapes j q }

theorem cfgRecord_inj {k : ℕ} {Q T : Type} {x : List Bool} (s : ℕ) {c d : Cfg k Bool Q x}
    {τ τ' : T} (hc : WindowedP s c) (hd : WindowedP s d) :
    cfgRecord s c τ = cfgRecord s d τ' ↔
      (c.state = d.state ∧ c.inputPos = d.inputPos ∧ c.workTapes = d.workTapes ∧
        c.workTapePos = d.workTapePos) ∧ τ = τ'

theorem exists_inputSeekTM :
    ∃ (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S) (R : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S) (entry exit : S)
      (C : ℕ),

        (∀ q, d.workTapes 1 q = none) →
        ∃ t ≤ C * (w.length + d.inputPos.val + p + 1),
          (∀ u < t, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
          (∀ u ≤ t, ∀ j : Fin 2,
            |(R.runFrom d u).workTapePos j - d.workTapePos j| ≤ ((C * (w.length + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∧
          (R.runFrom d t).state = some exit ∧ ((R.runFrom d t).inputPos : ℕ) = p ∧
          (R.runFrom d t).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ (R.runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos ∧
          (R.runFrom d t).output = d.output

name: Complexity.Turing.exists_inputSeekTM
header:
theorem exists_inputSeekTM :
    ∃ (S : Type) (_ : Fintype S) (_ : DecidableEq S) (R : MultiTapeTM 2 Bool S) (entry exit : S)
      (C : ℕ),
      ∀ {x : List Bool} (p : ℕ) (w : List Bool), Nat.ofDigits 2 (w.map Bool.toNat) = p →
        p ≤ x.length + 1 → ∀ d : Cfg 2 Bool S x, d.state = some entry →
        (∀ q : ℤ, -1 ≤ q → q ≤ (w.length : ℤ) →
          d.workTapes 0 (d.workTapePos 0 + q) = FinTM.bufferTape w q) →
        (∀ q, d.workTapes 1 q = none) →
        ∃ t ≤ C * (w.length + d.inputPos.val + p + 1),
          (∀ u < t, (R.runFrom d u).state ≠ some exit) ∧
          (R.runFrom d t).state = some exit ∧ ((R.runFrom d t).inputPos : ℕ) = p ∧
          (R.runFrom d t).workTapes = d.workTapes ∧ (R.runFrom d t).workTapePos = d.workTapePos ∧
          (R.runFrom d t).output = d.output
